name: 3S Mercenary
author: Joakim
description: Your hired mercenary's HUD, fed by the five Merc.* GMCP packages (3Scapes only, any guild - a merc is an NPC anyone can hire, so this lives beside 3s-vitals rather than inside a guild plugin). Status: HP, stamina and action points as gauges, the merc's own target and how much of it is left, name, class, weapon type, permanent and instance level against their caps, regen, and whether it is following or dormant. Stats: this session's rounds, damage dealt and taken, healing and abilities beside the lifetime twins, xp toward the next permanent and instance level, and what has been spent on what. Talents and Skills: every allocation with its points, effective value and level gate, and the cost of the next point - the 'can I afford to train yet' question, answered from the feed. 'merc' prints the Status page; the panel does the rest. Built from one capture (Goran, 2 Sep 2026): every field shown was seen, and the ones a capture cannot name (dormant, status, cost, theme, abils) are shown raw under their own names until a player says what they are.
